device_name: AMD Radeon Pro W7900 Dual Slot
notes: Per-class gfx1100 seed calibration from in-kernel HW_REG_SHADER_CYCLES slopes. See docs/Gfx1100CalibrationMethodology.md for raw slopes and subtraction rules.

WriteSALU.notes: 16 dependent s_add_i32 ops per loop iter. Slope 67.995 cyc/iter; branch-loop baseline 22.000; solved with Write32Bit=3.87 -> 3.12 cyc/op, rounded to 3.

Write32Bit.notes: 16 dependent v_add_nc_u32 ops per loop iter. Slope 80.117 cyc/iter minus 22.000 branch-loop baseline leaves 15 extra VALU ops -> 3.87 cyc/op, rounded to 4.

WriteVMEM.notes: 4 ordered buffer_store_b32 ops per loop iter. Slope 741.796 cyc/iter; subtract branch-loop baseline and 3 extra VALU ops -> 177.0 cyc/store.

WriteLDS.notes: 4 ds_load_b32 + dependent VALU consumers per loop iter. Slope 222.000 cyc/iter; subtract branch-loop baseline and 3 extra VALU ops -> 47.1 cyc/load.

WriteBranch.notes: Loop body contains one v_add_nc_u32 plus loop s_add_i32/s_cmp_lt_i32/s_cbranch_scc1. Slope 22.000; subtract Write32Bit and two WriteSALU ops -> 12 cyc/branch.
